dis.text: Tin Street Market is where the hussar Modar, riding Ashmane through the bazaar, hears a man's last cry and finds blood in an alley, and a woman in Boros uniform standing over an ogre's corpse.
When he tries to stop her, the shapeshifter takes the exact form of the dead ogre, and Modar stabs her with his gladius but escapes only by tearing his brooch free and summoning Ashmane.
Returning to the alley he finds the body and blood gone, so he announces from the market stage that he is investigating deaths, repeating his name to bait the shapeshifter.
The shapeshifter, now a troll, seizes him by the throat, and an Azorius arrest team tears the tent apart as Modar pulls its claws into his chest while it takes his form.
